guided_fallback.lede: No verified provider fits every answer you gave. Rather than show you nothing, here are the closest matches — with exactly what each one does not meet.

matching_policy.prevention_note: Filtering is monotone, so an option that empties the candidate set at pick time would empty it on every path through it. Such an option is offered DISABLED with a published reason rather than allowed to dead-end. If every option of a question would be dead, none is disabled and the guided closest-matches fallback explains the result instead.
matching_policy.result_scope_reason: Return all eligible matches in evidence order, rather than permanently hiding unpriced providers below a three-result cap. Missing prices cannot enter the cost lane; non-price attributes and all existing constraints remain.
matching_policy.state_routing_note: geographic availability only, from dated research evidence; never excludes without explicit provider-published evidence (2026-08-06)
